scope: Per-opcode c2s coverage report. Cross-joins operation_opcode_map_outbound.json (the c2s catalog: 4 operationClasses + serverboundGap + static-emitter bindings) against pcap_validation c2sOpcodeHistogram (23 distinct observed in the 54-pcap corpus). For each c2s opcode: notes decomp anchor (BCS-Y id + emitter VA), pcap evidence (observed count, witness pcaps, payload size from extractor/the c2s-payload-schemas pass/the c2s-payload-decoding pass), and overall confidence. Identifies gaps in three categories.

conventions.confidence: confirmed (decomp + pcap with matching size) | likely (decomp anchor only OR pcap only with size matching emitter static size) | speculative (catalog says it exists but no static emitter and no pcap occurrence)

decompMissing.interpretation: The seven opcodes above have a server-side bahamut anchor but no client-side static emitter pinned in the ZoneOutbound/Operation sweeps. These are NOT 'no emitter exists' - by BCS-Y-0332's 'finalGapStatus: 0 unbound' claim, every direct/Tier-C/Tier-D caller of the Zone and Chat send gates has a binding. The remaining gap is that the catalog attributes them at the Zone-channel level (via the BCS-Y-0312 generic forwarder) without a specific per-opcode emitter function. Five of these seven ARE observed in pcaps, so their bindings exist but live behind the channel-generic forwarder rather than in a per-opcode emitter; resolving requires opcode-imm-search inside the calling 'caller-of-FUN_004E0240' set.

The c2s catalog FULLY COVERS observed c2s pcap traffic.

sizeMismatch.description: Opcodes where the documented static emitter size does NOT match the observed pcap payload size.
sizeMismatch.interpretation: No size mismatches found. The five c2s opcodes with both static size AND pcap-derived inner length (0x0007, 0x00CA, 0x00CC, 0x00CD, 0x01DD) all show exact match: staticSize - 0x10 (16-byte game-msg prefix) = pcapInnerLen. The pcap-grounded-c2s-validation pass's 0x01DD validation in particular grounds the match (staticSize 0x118 = 280 bytes; pcap payload 264 bytes; 280 - 16 = 264).

confirmed.criteria: Decomp anchor (BCS-Y emitter) AND pcap observation. Size match verified where the c2s-payload-schemas/c2s-payload-decoding decode exists.
confirmed.note: 0x00CE/0x012D/0x012E/0x012F/0x0133 are observed in pcaps but missing per-opcode BCS-Y emitter; they are 'confirmed' by bahamut-anchor + pcap evidence + Zone-channel generic-forwarder attribution. The strict decomp-emitter binding is in the decompMissing gap list.

likely.criteria: Decomp anchor only (no pcap observation; opcode not exercised by the 54-capture corpus). Includes all Lobby-phase opcodes (0x04, 0x05, 0x0B, 0x0F, 0x01F5, 0x01F6) and most recruiting/social/FAQ/GM-ticket opcodes (0x01C3..0x01D6 minus the four observed).

speculative.criteria: Catalog entry exists but neither static emitter nor pcap evidence found.
speculative.note: After consolidation, no purely-speculative c2s entries remain. BCS-Y-0332's 'finalGapStatus: 0 unbound' is corroborated at this synthesis layer.

synthesisFindings: All 23 c2s opcodes observed in the 54-pcap corpus are cataloged. No pcap-without-catalog gap exists for in-range opcodes.

Out of 49 distinct cataloged c2s opcodes, 21 have both decomp+pcap evidence (confirmed), 27 have decomp anchor only (likely), 1 is borderline. The unobserved-in-pcap opcodes split into two groups: (a) Lobby-phase opcodes 0x04/0x05/0x0B/0x0F/0x01F5/0x01F6 not captured by the post-login corpus, and (b) low-frequency feature opcodes (recruiting/social/FAQ/GM) not exercised by the captured scenarios.

Per-opcode decomp emitter coverage: ~42 of 49 c2s opcodes have a specific BCS-Y-attributed emitter function. The 7 opcodes in decompMissing (0x00CE, 0x00CF, 0x012D, 0x012E, 0x012F, 0x0133, 0x0135) are bahamut-anchored but only Zone-channel generic-forwarder routed (via BCS-Y-0312 / 0304); per-opcode static emitter functions for these have not been individually pinned yet.

Size reconciliation: every opcode with both a static-emitter size AND a decoded pcap payload size shows exact match (staticSize - 16-byte game-msg prefix = pcapInnerLen). 0x0007 (24=16+8), 0x00CA (48=16+32), 0x00CC (24=16+8), 0x00CD (24=16+8), 0x01DD (280=16+264) all validated.
Two bidirectional opcode collisions documented: 0x000F (c2s CharaMakeOperation::SelectCharacterConfirm vs s2c GameLoginOperation response) and 0x01DD.
Two channel-disambiguation cases: 0x0003 (Map chat 0x230 vs Lobby ServiceLogin 0x20) and 0x0006 (Map LanguageCode 0x18 vs Lobby LobbyLogin step3 0x1E0).
outOfScopeNotes: Did NOT edit symbols.json (read-only per phase rules); did NOT push/commit.
Did NOT re-run pcap extractors; relied on the published pcap-validation-pass histogram and the c2s-payload-schemas/c2s-payload-decoding payload schemas.
The 'all 14 Tier-D thunk callers' in BCS-Y-0332 are tallied as one synthesis-level decomp anchor per opcode, not enumerated individually here.

Lobby-phase emitters (0x04/0x05/0x06/0x0B/0x0F/0x01F5/0x01F6) marked 'likely' rather than 'speculative' because they have unique vftable[0] SendRequest functions and complete attribution; absence from corpus reflects the corpus boundary, not catalog confidence.

The c2s_bridge_skeleton.json 'verifiedOutboundBindings: 9' count represents Lua-to-opcode bindings (CharaBase._setPosition -> 0x00CA, etc.), distinct from the BCS-Y static emitter attribution count tracked here.
